categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two main business segments: photoresists (including PCB photoresists, display photoresists, and photovoltaic adhesives) and coatings (including 3C consumer electronics coatings, automotive coatings, heavy-duty anti-corrosion coatings, functional film coatings, and metal packaging coatings). These products fall within the photocurable fine chemicals domain.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes UV light curing technology and thermal curing technology as core manufacturing methods. Production processes include liquid formulation, mixing, dispersion, grinding, secondary dispersion, filtration, and packaging. The company has developed proprietary formulations for resins, monomers, photoinitiators, and solvents, with capabilities in both synthesis and application optimization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include PCB manufacturers, display panel producers, photovoltaic component manufacturers, 3C consumer electronics brands (smartphones, smartwatches, earbuds), automotive manufacturers, and industrial equipment producers. Key end markets include printed circuit boards, flat panel displays, solar photovoltaic cells, consumer electronics, automotive components, and heavy-duty corrosion protection applications.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with major production bases in Jiangsu Province (Jiangyin), Hunan Province (Changsha), and Jiangxi Province (Longnan). The company has regional operating centers in East China and South China to serve the concentrated PCB and electronics manufacturing regions in the Yangtze River Delta and Pearl River Delta areas.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream to downstream segments of the chemical supply chain. It sources raw materials (resins, monomers, photoinitiators, solvents) from upstream chemical suppliers and sells finished photoresists and coatings directly to downstream manufacturers in electronics, automotive, and industrial sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing environmentally-friendly coatings (UV-curable, solvent-free, and water-based formulations), advancing photovoltaic material solutions for emerging battery technologies (BC, TOPCon, HJT cells), expanding into automotive and heavy-duty corrosion protection markets, and establishing the Longnan production base as a centralized manufacturing hub. R&D focuses on high-performance materials, process innovation, and application-specific solutions.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of photoresists and coatings to manufacturers. Revenue is recognized when customers take control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance for domestic sales, or upon obtaining shipping documents for export sales. The company operates on a made-to-order basis with some safety stock inventory.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with international giants like AkzoNobel, PPG, and Axalta in coatings, and with domestic competitors like Rongda Photosensitivity in photoresists. The company positions itself as a leading domestic manufacturer in PCB photoresists and emerging photovoltaic materials, with competitive advantages in product performance, technical service, and rapid innovation cycles.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company generated operating revenue of 518.23 million yuan in 2024, representing 1.63% growth from 509.94 million yuan in 2023. However, the company reported a net loss of 32.07 million yuan in 2024 compared to net income of 6.90 million yuan in 2023, primarily due to goodwill impairment charges and asset write-downs. Total assets were 1.176 billion yuan at year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates through advanced photocurable material technology, comprehensive environmental-friendly product portfolios, rapid product customization capabilities, strong technical service teams, and strategic positioning in emerging applications like photovoltaic BC battery materials. The company emphasizes sustainable solutions, high-performance specifications, and integrated system solutions that address customer needs for quality, efficiency, cost reduction, and environmental compliance.
